title: A complete first learning experience, one release at a time
subtitle: Online education · User story map · Original simulated proposal
goal: Understand the course, enroll and start the first lesson
footer: Simulated proposal · Input order is not a product commitment. Release slices are not calendar intervals.

releases.label: Make it work end to end
releases.goal: Select a course, enroll and reach the first lesson independently.

releases.label: Reduce uncertainty
releases.goal: Add trust and recovery information for a calmer first visit.

stories.label: Understand prerequisites
stories.detail: See who the course is for, prerequisite knowledge and a sample exercise.

stories.label: Confirm enrollment
stories.detail: Show the course, start-time zone and a clear next step after success.

stories.label: Reach the first lesson
stories.detail: Enter from confirmation or email; give the entry button an accessible name.

stories.label: Preview the learning experience
stories.detail: Offer a captioned preview and explain practice and support sessions.

stories.label: Recover from a missing email
stories.detail: Resend confirmation and show enrollment status to prevent duplicate payment.

stories.label: Find cancellation terms
stories.detail: Explain cancellation rules and support contacts before payment.
